title: WPMS/817/2019 of VIDYA CHAURASIA Vs RIYAZ HUSSAIN

paras.text:
WPMS No. 817 of 2019
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Sah, Advocate
for the petitioners.
 Mr. Dinesh Chandra Gahtori,
Advocate for the respondent.
 Time extension application (MCC
No. 368 of 2019) has been filed on behalf
of the petitioners seeking extension of
time for furnishing undertaking before
the Prescribed Authority.
 For the reasons stated, the time
extension application is allowed.
 Further 15 daysí time, from today,
is granted to the petitioners to furnish an
undertaking before the court below/
Prescribed Authority.
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
Parul 13.05.2019

Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Post Lunch:
As per the report of the Mediator
there are chances of amicable settlement
between the parties, and the matter is
fixed for 24.05.2019 for further attempts
at mediation.
List this case on 24.05.2019.
Parties shall remain present in
person before this Court on the date
fixed.
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
Parul 09.05.2019
